description: This source file contains unit tests for load shedding functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests how the system handles overload scenarios by simulating CPU load and verifying the gateway's response to overload conditions.

classes.name: LoadSheddingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for simulating and verifying load shedding behavior under overload conditions in Orleans. Contains setup fixtures, test methods, and internal methods to manipulate overload states.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Configuration fixture for setting up the Orleans test cluster with load shedding options enabled.

methods.name: LoadSheddingBasic
methods.description: Test that verifies the system rejects requests when overloaded by expecting a GatewayTooBusyException.

methods.name: LoadSheddingComplex
methods.description: Test that simulates overload and normal conditions, verifying that requests are shed during overload and accepted afterwards.

methods.name: LatchIsOverloaded
methods.description: Internal helper to simulate overload by increasing CPU usage percentage.

methods.name: UnlatchIsOverloaded
methods.description: Internal helper to simulate returning to non-overloaded state by resetting hardware statistics.
